title: Tensor pullback of kernel ideals under an ambient isomorphism
statement: Let i₁:Z→Z₁ and i₂:Z→Z₂ be closed immersions of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-scheme], and let φ:Z₁→Z₂ be an isomorphism such that i₁≫φ=i₂. Put Iⱼ=ker(O_{Zⱼ}→(iⱼ)_*O_Z) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] and Mⱼ=iⱼ*Iⱼ using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let ηⱼ:Iⱼ→(iⱼ)_*Mⱼ be the normalized tensor pullback adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], sending a local section to its pure tensor with 1. There exists an O_Z-module isomorphism e:M₂≅M₁ such that for every open U⊆Z₂, sections s₂∈I₂(U), s₁∈I₁(φ⁻¹U) whose structure-sheaf images satisfy ι₁(s₁)=φ♯(ι₂(s₂)), and every open W⊆Z with W⊆i₂⁻¹U and W⊆i₁⁻¹(φ⁻¹U), one has e_W(η₂,U(s₂)|_W)=η₁,φ⁻¹U(s₁)|_W. No uniqueness assertion is included in this lemma.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemmas 01R3 and 01R4, specialized to a common closed subscheme and an ambient isomorphism; Sheaves, Lemma 0096

proof.text: Apply the ideal-section clause of closedImmersion_conormal_functorial with the common subscheme map equal to the identity. Take the adjoint of its gamma under the chosen tensorPullback adjunction for the ambient morphism. The homEquiv_unit equation gives beta: I2 -> phi_* I1 and its exact structure-sheaf section equation on every open. This reuses the proved ideal construction rather than reconstructing kernel lifts.

For an arbitrary compatible ambient morphism, compose beta with pushforward of the chosen i1 pullback unit and pushforwardComp i1 phi. Substitute the square equality i2 = i1 >> phi and take the inverse Hom equivalence for i2. Its unit equation gives the formula at the full inverse-image open. Injectivity of toModulesiota identifies any prescribed compatible s1 with beta(s2); naturality of the module map gives the formula after restrictions to W. The category of opens is a preorder, so the two restriction arrows coincide.

Apply the preceding construction to phi and inv phi. Prove the general one-sided identity criterion: if phi >> psi is the identity and i2 >> psi = i1, any maps with the preceding section formulas have composite equal to the identity. Test its adjoint on an ideal section s1 over U. The beta map for psi supplies the intermediate ideal section s2. Transport s1 to phi inverse image of psi inverse image U; naturality of the ideal inclusion and Scheme.Hom.congr_app for phi >> psi = identity prove compatibility. Apply both section formulas on W = i1 inverse image U. Naturality of the unit and functoriality of restrictions cancel the transports, since the composite open arrow is the identity. Thus the composite fixes every unit section; injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection proves it is the identity. Apply this criterion in both directions and package the two maps and identities into an isomorphism, retaining the forward section formula.

theorem exists_kernelTensorPullbackIso {Z Z₁ Z₂ : Scheme.{u}}
    (i₁ : Z ⟶ Z₁) (i₂ : Z ⟶ Z₂) [IsClosedImmersion i₁] [IsClosedImmersion i₂]
    (φ : Z₁ ⟶ Z₂) [IsIso φ] (hc : i₁ ≫ φ = i₂) :
    ∃ e : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i₂).obj i₂.ker.toModules ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i₁).obj i₁.ker.toModules,
          ∀ (U : Z₂.Opens) (s₂ : Γ(i₂.ker.toModules, U))
            (s₁ : Γ(i₁.ker.toModules, φ ⁻¹ᵁ U)),
            i₁.ker.toModulesι.app (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U) s₁ =
              φ.app U (i₂.ker.toModulesι.app U s₂) →
            ∀ (W : Z.Opens) (a : W ≤ i₂ ⁻¹ᵁ U) (b : W ≤ i₁ ⁻¹ᵁ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U)),
              e.hom.app W
                  (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i₂).obj i₂.ker.toModules).val.map (homOfLE a).op
                    (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                      i₂)).unit.app i₂.ker.toModules).app U s₂)) =
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i₁).obj i₁.ker.toModules).val.map (homOfLE b).op
                  (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                    i₁)).unit.app i₁.ker.toModules).app (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U) s₁)
